title: Application fee and admissions criteria — Steinberg
shortTitle: Application fee and admissions criteria — Steinberg
summary: A medical-school applicant pays a fee in reliance on stated evaluation criteria and alleges that different criteria were used.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

What performance did the institution promise in exchange for the fee? Distinguish a promise to evaluate in a particular way from a promise to admit. Identify the alleged acceptance and the effect of the published terms.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
